ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixel distribution covering approximately 88% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the trailing edge, distal tips, and internal focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity border along the posterior margin. Significant low-intensity clusters (blobs) are mapped as follows: a cluster of four discrete spots in the mid-left lobe, three discrete spots in the mid-right lobe, and a complex vertical cluster at the central peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 5% of the total fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge; pixel-amplitudes of irregular peaks and valleys range from 8 to 22 pixels relative to the mean boundary line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep of the trailing edges concluding in tapered, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10 discrete, high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters (likely barnacle scars) distributed across the white ventral plane, primarily concentrated in the medial-to-lateral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct, vertically-aligned low-intensity linear pixel disruptions located at the base of the fluke near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple dark focal marks and a distinct vertical 'ladder' pigmentation pattern at the peduncle interface.
